country: Democratic Republic of the Congo (Zaïre in 1984)
census: Recensement scientifique de la population, juillet 1984
the_only_census: No census has been taken since. The second (RGPH-2) was in its preparatory phase in September 2026, with census mapping under way in Kinshasa and no published date for enumeration.

source.title: Zaïre. Recensement scientifique de la population, juillet 1984. Totaux définitifs
source.publisher: République du Zaïre, Ministère du Plan et Aménagement du Territoire, Institut National de la Statistique

tables.T-01: Répartition de la population résidante du Zaïre par Région, printed page 12
tables.T-02: Répartition de la population résidante du Zaïre par Région et Sous-Région, printed pages 13 to 16

copy_read.held_by: IREDA, CEPED's inventory of African census and survey documents
copy_read.form: a 2010 scan with a recognised-text layer, 90 pages

read: the volume itself: no reproduction or rights notice
IREDA's pages: no terms of use
CEPED's legal notice (ceped.org/article/mentions-legales): personal data and the site's illustration photos only
licence.decision: Published as counts, transcribed and cited, with this provenance stated, by the practitioner's decision of 2026-11-19: "The tables then become curated with stated provenance."
licence.redistributed: the counts only, transcribed and cited; the scanned volume is not redistributed

transcription.by: read from the recognised-text layer, and from the page image wherever the text layer failed a check
errors_found_in_the_text_layer: Bandundu total 3169141 and Équateur men 1143196 in T-02, where T-01 and the page image read 3769741 and 1743196
Zongo, Bukavu and Kananga rows unreadable as text

units: counts.csv: the country, 9 regions, and their 44 cities (villes) and sub-regions (sous-régions), as printed. A ville is a unit of the same level as a sous-région: a region's total is the sum of both. units.csv, the mapping to today's provinces, HDX P-codes and geoBoundaries IDs, is not written yet.
